name: device-login-relay

graded_by.test: core/internal/ws/device_login_test.go — TestPromptsReachOnlyTheCreatorsSocketAndTheSocketBecomesTheAttach: the frames above reach the creator's socket only, no other client sees one, and after the result the same socket receives attached

description: What crosses C2 for one device login, as the frames a creator's socket carries, in order: `device_login_attach` redeems the one-time ticket; the device's host key, prompts and banner arrive as `device_login_*` frames the core relays unread (Contract §6: it checks only kinds, counts and lengths); `device_login_answer` goes back; `device_login_result` ends it. The prompts reach only the creator's socket: no other client can see a device login, because it is not a session, is not listed, and its ticket was handed to its creator alone. On `device_login_result` with outcome `connected` the same socket continues in the attach order from `attached`, and the recording warning is shown before any input (session-attach CR6). The answers cross C2 and C3 only: never a data socket, the ring, the VT grid, a log, a manifest or the spool.

instances.note: 1: the creator redeems the ticket; the reader runs on the socket from the accept
2: the first-use key, when the worker has none on record
3: the operator's decision, audited before it is relayed

doc.text: Authorized use only. Activity is logged.

instances.note: 4: the banner, relayed in the order the device sent it
5: a round: the core relays it and holds it for the recording before it acts on anything later
6: the answer, relayed only when it names the outstanding prompt_id with one string per prompt
7: the result, then `attached` on the same socket
